sources.note: Homepage — describes ModMed as cloud-based EHR & services for specialty practices with EHR, practice management, RCM, AI, and patient engagement.
ONC certification/mandatory disclosures page — 2015 Edition compliant, certified by ONC-ACB. Minimal detail beyond compliance statement.
Dermatology product page — EHR, practice management, billing, RCM, and patient engagement tools for dermatology. Integrated PM with EMR. CPT, diagnosis, and referring doctor reporting.
Ophthalmology product page — all-in-one ophthalmology EHR/EMR software suite.
Ophthalmology image management — DICOM image import from OCTs, visual fields, corneal topographers, fundus cameras. Cloud storage, comparison views, annotations.
Ophthalmology subspecialties — EMA supports various ophthalmology subspecialties including glaucoma, retina.
Practice management page — described as hub for administrative tasks including medical billing and reports. Limited detail in rendered content.
Patient portal page — APPatient, gives patients access to healthcare information via web or mobile app. Limited feature detail in rendered content.
RCM page — full-service billing automation, claim submission to patient billing.
ASC software page — connects EHR, PM, scheduling, charting, and billing for surgery center operations.
Gastroenterology ASC page — gGastro ASC with endoscopy report writer, PM, anesthesia/nursing notes, cost estimators.
Lab integration page — electronic lab orders and results from connected clinical, pathology, and genetic labs.
Press release — gMed rebranded to Modernizing Medicine Gastroenterology at ACG 2018.
Press release — acquisition of Exscribe (orthopedic healthcare technology).
Press release — Clearlake Capital majority growth investment, ModMed described as leading healthcare SaaS platform.
Press release (Nov 2024) — ModMed Scribe AI ambient documentation, 40,000+ providers mentioned.
Press release — G2 2025 Best Software Awards recognition for EHR, PM, RCM, and patient engagement.
Press release — KLAS top-rated specialty EHR.
EMRFinder profile — detailed feature list including Interactive Anatomical Atlas, Virtual Exam Room, adaptive learning, structured data for MIPS/value-based care. Covers 11 specialties.
EHR in Practice profile — AI-powered specialty EHR with 9+ modules. Lists specialties, ModMed Scribe trained on 750M encounters, gScribe for GI. Cloud-based, HIPAA/ICD-10/CPT/HL7 compliant.
Look for Zebras article — top features including specialty customization, adaptive documentation, telehealth, RCM, patient portal with messaging and payment, mobile app with Apple Health/Google Fit.
Refresh Miami — Clearlake Capital buying majority stake at $5.3B valuation (March 2025). 160,000+ specialty physicians cited.
Bloomberg Law — Clearlake/ModMed deal at $5.3B, from Warburg Pincus.
KLAS Research vendor page for ModMed — ratings and reviews. (Not fetched, but referenced in search results for KLAS recognition.)
Software Finder ModMed profile — pricing, features, reviews for 2026.
EMR Systems profile — EMA features including billing workflow, clearinghouse interface, claim scrubbing, automated submission, remittance posting, rejection/denial analytics.
